title: Transferability of Error Bounds and the Kurdyka-Łojasiewicz Property under $C^1$ Partial Smoothness
summary: This work studies how a generalized error bound (GEB) property in the ambient Euclidean space transfers to the active manifold under $C^1$ partial smoothness. The GEB generalizes the standard error bound, which upper bounds the distance to a subset of critical points using first-order stationarity residuals, by allowing the distance to be composed with a gauge function. In the ambient space, these residuals are measured by the subdifferential or the slope of the original function, while on the manifold they are measured by the Riemannian gradient or the slope of the restricted function.
